names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 12 aprilie, «Sfântul Ierarh Vasile Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Pariei»; the bare personal name, without the rank the line carries.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 12 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Св. Василије исповедник.“, with Св. left off — it is not a rank — and with исповедник left off as well, the rank word this source uses for a confessor, which this folder already carries in `types`. The heading leaves no epithet and names neither the see nor the province; both are in the body, and this corpus keeps a see in `office`. The bare form is shared with three other folders and that fold is deliberate and recorded.

attestations.note: The day's second entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian keeps him on; the Russian and the Greek rows stay `undocumented`, since neither source was read for him. The man is the same beyond doubt: the bishop of Parium in Asia Minor who refused to sign the imperial paper against the veneration of the icons. **A death of «the first half of the eighth century» was added where this folder had none** — „Сконча у првој половини VIII века“ — recorded as the interval 701–750, which is what the phrase says and no narrower; doxologia.ro's line, the folder's only other source, prints no year at all. `node .tmp/dd.mjs "first half of the 8th century"` reads in Russian and Greek, so no era label had to be placed in the locale packs. New besides the date: that he was **much persecuted and tortured** for the refusal, and that **he stayed firm in Orthodoxy like a diamond** — the entry's own figure. **The fold is deliberate and it widens one already on file**: the stored Василије is the same bare form `basileus-of-cherson`, `basil-the-confessor` and `basil-of-ancyra` hold, a set the run's findings recorded on the Serbian 7. and 22. март ст. ст., and this is a fourth folder joining it; the heading gives a rank word this folder already carries in `types` and nothing else, and the see is in the body and kept in `office`. Recorded in the findings before this was committed. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion, and this folder has no hymn from any source.

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţelor, învăţător înfrânârii te-a arătat pe tine, turmei tale, adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai dobândit cu smerenia cele înalte şi cu sărăcia cele bogate; Părinte Ierarhe Vasile, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Vasile Mărturisitorul, Episcop de Parion», Glasul 4; the reading «înfrânârii» is the page's own

english.text: A rule of faith and an image of gentleness, a teacher of abstinence: so the truth of things has shown you to your flock. Therefore you gained by humility the things on high, and by poverty the things that are rich. Father and hierarch Basil, entreat Christ God to save our souls.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 12 April: „Сконча у првој половини VIII века, и пресели се ка Господу.“ — he ended in the first half of the eighth century. The interval is the phrase and nothing narrower: no year is printed and none was chosen inside it. It is the only dating any source read for this folder gives — doxologia.ro's line «Sfântul Vasile Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Pariei» prints no year — and the iconoclasm the entry sets him in is consistent with it. `node .tmp/dd.mjs "first half of the 8th century"` reads in Russian and Greek.
